bug_description.original: Use-of-uninitialized-value in ihevcd_fmt_conv OSS-Fuzz report: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=484466027 ``` Crash type: Use-of-uninitialized-value Crash state: ihevcd_fmt_conv ihevcd_process_thread ```
bug_description.normalized: During decode, libhevc converts decoded YUV rows to `IV_RGB_565` output and consumes an uninitialized value inside `ihevcd_fmt_conv`.

source.description: Project create code stores the caller-selected output format in codec state; that state later controls which format-conversion branch and function pointer `ihevcd_fmt_conv` uses.
source.value_from: Harness-controlled `create_ip.s_ivd_create_ip_t.e_output_format`, which is chosen from `supportedColorFormats` and can be `IV_RGB_565`.

root_cause.description: The RGB565 converter reads chroma bytes through `pu1_u_src` and `pu1_v_src` and immediately derives color-channel deltas from them without any local initialization or validity check, so uninitialized source samples propagate into later pixel computation.

sink.code: fmt_conv_fptr(pu1_y_src, pu1_uv_src, pu2_rgb_dst_tmp, ps_codec->i4_disp_wd, num_rows, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_disp_strd, is_u_first);
sink.description: `ihevcd_fmt_conv` invokes the RGB565 conversion callback on decoded Y and UV planes. MemorySanitizer reports the use of uninitialized value at this call site in the crashing run.

relation.right: (pu1_y_src, pu1_uv_src, pu2_rgb_dst_tmp, ps_codec->i4_disp_wd, num_rows, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_disp_strd, is_u_first)

tainted_value_origin.description: The fuzz harness chooses the decoder output-format enum from a fixed array that includes `IV_RGB_565`; the project later stores that enum into codec state.

fine_trace.note: The create path materializes the caller-selected output format into project codec state. For the crashing run, this state must be `IV_RGB_565` to reach the MSAN-reported sink at the RGB565 call site.

Before conversion, project output-buffer validation follows the RGB565 branch when the stored format equals `IV_RGB_565`, confirming that decode continues with RGB565-specific output requirements rather than another format path.
The format-conversion dispatcher selects the RGB565 branch when the stored output format is `IV_RGB_565`; this control decision leads directly to the callback call at the sanitizer location.

fine_trace.code: fmt_conv_fptr(pu1_y_src, pu1_uv_src, pu2_rgb_dst_tmp, ps_codec->i4_disp_wd, num_rows, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_strd, ps_codec->i4_disp_strd, is_u_first);
fine_trace.note: `ihevcd_fmt_conv` passes the current decoded luma/chroma pointers and RGB565 destination into the selected converter. The saved MSAN trace identifies this exact statement as the use-of-uninitialized-value crash site.

Inside the RGB565 converter, the first per-pixel blue delta is computed directly from `*pu1_u_src`. If that chroma byte is uninitialized, the uninitialized state is consumed here and propagated through subsequent RGB packing operations.
The converter combines the luma byte with the derived blue delta to produce an output channel value. This carries the earlier uninitialized contribution into the emitted RGB565 pixel data.

format.contract: The testcase must drive the harness to request `IV_RGB_565` as decoder output format and then reach the `IV_RGB_565` conversion branch in `ihevcd_fmt_conv`.

parser_admitted.description: The accepted continuation for the crashing input is the project RGB565 conversion branch reached during decode after output-buffer validation has already admitted RGB565 output handling.
